catalysts.headline: Bradley Heppner's criminal sentencing hearing (SDNY) has reportedly been rescheduled to January 11, 2027. This is a single-source report (Panabee); no second independent outlet or court-docket confirmation was found this session, and it supersedes the prior 'adjourned, no new date set' status on file (as of 2026-10-22).

Beneficient reportedly filed a motion to intervene in existing litigation seeking to recover approximately $211 million previously paid on HCLP-related obligations, alongside its ongoing strategy (on file from 2026-09-23) to void ~$130M in disputed HCLP Nominees debt.
catalysts.note: This detail is drawn from WebSearch-engine synthesis of the Panabee article title/summary; panabee.com could not be directly fetched this session (WebFetch returned host-unreachable for it), so the specifics (motion type, exact $211M figure, exact date) should be treated as moderately confident, not primary-source-verified.

catalysts.headline: A Southern District of New York spokesperson confirmed Bradley Heppner's criminal sentencing 'was adjourned without a new date' — as of this date, NO new sentencing date has been set. Judge Rakoff approved Heppner's removal of his former Quinn Emanuel attorneys; he has retained new counsel (Alexandra Shapiro, Jonathan Bach, consistent with on-file info) and reportedly plans to appeal.
catalysts.source: InvestmentNews, 'GWG's Heppner hires Puff Daddy's attorneys as criminal sentencing looms', dated 2026-10-22

catalysts.headline: 8-K filed disclosing a debt-letter-agreement amendment, effective 2026-10-07, between Beneficient and HH-BDH that pushed back a $1,000,000 cash-payment deadline owed to HH-BDH to March 31, 2027.

Bradley Heppner's criminal sentencing hearing (originally scheduled for this date before Judge Jed S. Rakoff, SDNY) was delayed indefinitely after his defense counsel (Quinn Emanuel) withdrew, citing a 'complete breakdown in communications'; he has since retained new counsel (Alexandra Shapiro, Jonathan Bach)
catalysts.impact: Sentencing did NOT occur on the date in the prior file (2026-10-21) nor on the originally scheduled 2026-10-07 date; a new sentencing date was not found in this session's searches

catalysts.headline: Beneficient announces a strategy to eliminate ~$130M in disputed HCLP Nominees debt and void Bradley Heppner's Class B equity/voting/board-appointment rights; plan would also convert ~$850M in preferred liquidation preference into ~162,132 Class A shares and void ~$88M of other obligations owed to Heppner/affiliates
catalysts.impact: Reported sharply positive stock reaction (one secondary source cited a ~194% single-day jump); plan is a proposed strategy — company states no definitive agreement has been secured yet, and it is prepared to litigate if no consensual resolution is reached

catalysts.headline: Beneficient announces strategy to eliminate HCLP debt and Heppner equity interests -- voids ~$130M disputed HCLP Nominees debt, exchanges ~$850M preferred liquidation preference for 162,132 Class A shares, and extinguishes another ~$88M in obligations; aims to end Brad Heppner's Class B super-voting/board/consent rights before his Oct 21, 2026 sentencing
catalysts.impact: stock spiked as high as +358% intraday before reversing sharply

catalysts.headline: A Manhattan federal jury convicts Bradley Heppner (Beneficient/GWG Holdings founder) on all four counts: securities fraud, wire fraud, conspiracy, and false statements to auditors
catalysts.impact: Negative overhang resolved in part — Beneficient called it a verdict that 'closes an important chapter' and said it had parted ways with Heppner upon learning of the fraud
